newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil stronger at close on bullish data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil stronger at close on bullish data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Mar (3rd pos) 1,268 rgt/tonne Jan (south) 1,310*
Open/Hi/Low 1,260/1,275/1,256 Prev close 1,310
Prev settlement 1,260 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed stronger boosted by bullish Ivan Wong's December crop estimates. Trading was widespread and a lot of switching was seen from spot to nearby futures. March futures rose to a 1,275 high but some profitaking was seen at highs.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Active buying in spot crude palm oil and refiners' covering helped strengthen prices.
The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) is due to announce the December crop data on January 15.

On Tuesday, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said Malaysia's palm oil output in December is estimated to have fallen by 17.4 percent to 630,000 tonnes from November. He put end-December palm oil stocks at 805,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 955,965 tonnes at end-November.
Exports in December is estimated at 660,000 tonnes against PORLA's 632,441 tonnes in November.

"There was still a squeeze in January futures and people were covering and buying. That's the reason why the market also moved up," a trader said. He added that the firmer sentiment then spilled over to other positions.
Traders noted a lot of switching activities from spot to nearby futures contracts. Interest was widespread and volume on the futures market totalled 3,270 lots.
January futures closed 20 ringgit higher at 1,293 ringgit a tonne and February futures contract was up 15 at 1,285.
Third and most active month March futures ended up eight ringgit at 1,268 ringgit ($507.30) after rising to 1,275.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,310 ringgit against bids at 1,305, after trading from 1,300 to 1,310.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,305 and bids at 1,300, with earlier trades at between 1,290 and 1,300.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,310 with bids at 1,305 with earlier trades at 1,300 and 1,305, and Feb (central) was offered at 1,305 and bids at 1,295.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $550 FOB Malaysia and Feb/Mar at $545. Feb/Mar was traded at $540.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $582.50, Feb at $580 and Mar at $575. Feb was traded from $570 to $575, and Mar at $570 and $572.50.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $417.50 and Feb at $420. Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $300.
